opening.argument: The title calls this a Terra Luna meme about a stablecoin that is not stable, and the description says its value fell by more than 99% that week. That framing matters: the dialogue first presents the coin as safe, with staking rewards and a character ready to put in their life savings, then challenges the claim that it cannot be dumped. The reversal makes the earlier assurances the subject of the satire. Despite mentioning rewards and an investment, the video does not ask viewers to buy, deposit money, provide data, or visit a destination.
